topic_thesis: Trading gurus don't make their fortunes in the stock market; they make guaranteed millions selling introductory course tickets to hopeful retail investors who face a 90% statistical failure rate.

key_statistic: 90% retail trader loss rate vs 100% risk-free profit for course gurus
target_emotion: Cynical realization and anger at predatory financial gurus
